olivia.cust: Hey team, our mobile SDK started getting 400s from /v1/rerank this morning after a client update. Happens on ~20% of requests. body attached.

aria.support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact request payload (no secrets) and headers? also which SDK version? :thinking_face:

olivia.cust: SDK v2.5.1. Payload looks fine to us, but here's the minimal repro we used:

olivia.cust: ```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

{
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {"id": "1", "text": "Candidate A"},
      {"id": "2", "text": "Candidate B"}
    ],
    "query": "Which is better?"
  }
}
```

aria.support: Thanks — that envelope with top-level `data` will cause our request validator to not find the required top-level `items`/`query` keys. Our schema expects `items` and `query` at the top-level, not nested. The server returns: `400 Bad Request - Missing required key: items`.

parse-bot: AUTO: request.validation_failed {"missing_keys": ["items", "query"]} /v1/rerank 3071234567

sam.eng: Confirming. I reproduced locally with the exact payload and got the same 400. Quick repro steps: curl below.

sam.eng: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"data":{"items":[{"id":"1","text":"A"}],"query":"q"}}' | jq
```

sam.eng: Response: `{"error":"Bad Request","message":"Missing required key: items"}`

aria.support: Root cause: some mobile clients wrap payloads in an envelope for analytics (key `data` or `payload`). SDK v2.5.1 changed serialization for iOS when using the network shim — bug.

jess.pm: Any customer impact on billing or rate limits?

aria.support: No tokens were consumed (validation fails before decoding), so no billing impact. Rate limits unaffected.

sam.eng: Short-term mitigation: SDK patch to unwrap envelope before send, and server-side we can add a friendly hint for common wrappers so we return a clearer error message. I'll open an internal ticket.

sam.eng: Work item: ENG-4521 — add pre-validate unwrap for keys ["data","payload","body"] and improve error text.

olivia.cust: Thanks. We'll patch the mobile clients to stop wrapping. Can you add a short repro snippet to the support ticket so our mobile team can fix quicker?

aria.support: Done — added the curl example and the exact error JSON to the ticket. Closing thread once SDK patch released. :white_check_mark:

olivia.cust: Appreciate it, will follow up when mobile rollout is complete.
